correctness_confidence.basis: Theorems 3.1 and 4.1, Corollary 4.2 and Proposition 5.1 withstand analytic checking. Independent exact arithmetic verifies all generic overlap entries from the original bases; full-channel checks at 209 parameters agree to 1.23e-15. Only a minor decimal error was found.

rigor.basis: The finite-dimensional spectral decomposition, three-interval optimality proof and product-vector compression bound are valid. The main omitted overlap algebra is reproducible and was independently checked, but displaying the remaining representative amplitudes would improve the self-contained proof.

novelty.basis: RLE already supplied the bases, subfamily and geometric objective; the frame machinery and MUB spectral bound are established. The exact subfamily spectrum, unique 73/100 optimum and rational objective reversal are plausible narrow new results. Focused primary-source searches found no earlier identical optimization, without certifying priority.

significance.basis: A useful exact worked example and product-measurement comparison, with limited scope: one known subfamily, equal weights, unit event rate. It does not settle the two-parameter or unrestricted four-basis problems, and the rate improvement over the RLE distance optimizer is about 0.216 percent.

reproducibility.basis: The PDF gives explicit matrices and analytic proofs. The supplied author verifier passes all 20 checks, and independent generic and full-channel checks pass. However, the review request states that verify.py and requirements.txt were absent from published v1, despite Section 6 describing an accompanying supplement and run record.

summary: This exact seven-page v1 supports its central mathematical claims: the complete Gram spectrum, unique 73/100 rate optimum at u=7/10 within the stated RLE branch, distance/rate reversal, and sharp 2/3 product-vector ceiling. Independent exact checks started from the original basis matrices, not just the asserted Gram ansatz. Recommend minor revision to correct the published-supplement description and the inaccurate decimal 0.6945524 (the cubic root is 0.694552035120...). No unresolved objection capable of invalidating a main result remains. Novelty is credible but incremental and priority is not exhaustively certified. The requested runtime is OpenAI gpt-6-astra at xhigh; backend configuration and technical workspace/memory isolation cannot be independently attested. Prior model participation remains unknown.
strengths: The complete 24-dimensional Gram spectrum and the 35-dimensional traceless-channel nullity are handled correctly, including eigenvalue collisions.
The exact optimality proof covers the entire closed parameter interval and proves uniqueness without relying on numerical optimization.
The product-vector argument applies even to orthonormal product bases that are not tensor products of fixed local bases; invariance of the compressed local subspace is unnecessary.
The author clearly attributes the RLE construction, fixes event-rate and probability normalization, and avoids claiming global four-basis optimality.
All 20 supplied exact checks passed; an independently written verifier established generic overlaps and tested the full channel at 209 parameters.
weaknesses: The scientific advance is restricted to an existing one-parameter construction and uses elementary frame and spectral methods; broader optimization and implementation advantages remain unproved.
Section 6 describes an accompanying verifier and verification.json, but those reproducibility assets were not part of published v1 according to the supplied release facts.

The manuscript compresses the essential generic overlap calculation to direct multiplication and one representative amplitude. The identity is correct, but fuller algebra would make verification easier.
Primary-source checking supports the attribution but does not provide an exhaustive priority search or establish the product-vector bound as a novel general principle.
potential_errors: Minor numerical error on page 5: the real root of 112u^3-192u^2+111u-22 is 0.694552035120092..., which rounds to 0.6945520 at seven decimal places, not 0.6945524. The stated approximate rate 0.728425 and all exact results remain correct.
The supplementary-material availability statements in Section 6 require correction or a properly versioned public supplement; a review-time rerun cannot establish that the files accompanied v1.
strong_novelty_candidates: The signed/symmetric overlap decomposition yielding the explicit complete spectrum of the specified RLE subfamily.
The exact unique equal-weight rate-one optimum gamma=73/100 at u=7/10 and the rational witness separating spectral and mean-distance optimization.
